bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money to the Minnesota Rare Disease Advisory Council.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA RARE DISEASE ADVISORY COUNCIL. +]

[+$342,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $342,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Rare Disease Advisory Council for purposes of Minnesota Statutes, section 256.4835. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money to the Minnesota Rare Disease Advisory Council.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA RARE DISEASE ADVISORY COUNCIL.

$342,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $342,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Rare Disease Advisory Council for purposes of Minnesota Statutes, section 256.4835.
additions: APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA RARE DISEASE ADVISORY COUNCIL.

$342,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $342,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Rare Disease Advisory Council for purposes of Minnesota Statutes, section 256.4835.
